auditor_value: 2F at a: +2Fa anticlockwise; F at 2a: 2Fa clockwise (anticlockwise moment -2Fa); 3F at B: 3F sin30 x 4a = +6Fa anticlockwise

findings.quote: since all three look similar at first glance
findings.note: Vague cause stated with an idiom (at first glance); it does not name the actual error, which is assigning the sense of rotation without checking the direction of the force.
findings.fix: Treating the downward force F as anticlockwise like the other two instead of clockwise, by fixing the sense of rotation from the position of the force alone and not from its direction.

notes: Answer agrees. Each moment checked as r x F with A at the origin and the rod along +x: (a,0) x (0,2F) = +2Fa; (2a,0) x (0,-F) = -2Fa; (4a,0) x (-3F cos30, 3F sin30) = +6Fa. The first common-mistake entry (12Fa) follows from its cause.
